verdict.rationale: Trivy is a CLI-first scanner, so every documented capability is invoked programmatically through commands like `trivy image` and `trivy k8s`, and an official MCP plugin exposes scanning to agents. Community users report it is easy to automate and integrate into CI. However, the evidence shows no documented HTTP API: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and nothing establishes parity between a UI and an API surface. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API or OpenAPI spec, explicit evidence of UI-to-API feature parity, and independent hands-on confirmation of full programmatic coverage.
